value.description: The probate attorney who confronts Daniel about his search and suspects he is lying.
evidence: "You have been through every drawer in this house," Asha said, evenly.
"Daniel," she said, after a moment. "I have to ask. When you went through her desk, did you find anything you have not given me."
Asha had been a probate attorney for fourteen years and she had watched a great many people lie to her

value.description: The man who has been searching for paperwork and denies withholding anything from Asha.
